IntelloKids Educational videos for kids aged 3 to 10

Short lessons presented by Brainy, for each age group: shapes and feelings for the youngest, up to the water cycle and magnets for 7 to 10 year olds. Each one ends with a question to talk about together.

Get started →

🎁 Try everything free for 7 days, no card needed. One account covers up to 4 children.

🛡️ No ads · No chat with strangers · Parents in control

What your child learns

  • Science: water, magnets, plants, space and the senses
  • Early maths: shapes, counting and friends of 10
  • Words, feelings and healthy habits

Questions parents ask

Are the videos safe for young children?

Yes. No ads, no comments, no autoplay and no links to other websites. Each child sees the videos for their age.

Which languages are the videos in?

Every video is in English, French and Spanish, and switches with the site language.

Are the videos free?

Some are free for every family. The 7-day free trial opens them all, with no card needed.
